name: Divi Torque Lite – Divi Theme, Divi Builder & Extra Theme
author: Fahim Reza

sections.description:
Enhance your Divi page-building experience with 20+ free modules. Supercharge your website builder with user-friendly pro Divi modules and features like the Divi Popup Builder, Divi Mega Menu, and Divi Dark Mode, Divi Contact Form Submission, and more.

Demos | Pro Version

Fully Customizable

Every Divi module and extension offers extensive options to customize your website exactly how you envision it. Create nearly any design you can imagine.

Lightweight & Fast Loading

No extra bloat or messy code to slow down your website. Our modules are optimized for fast loading and seamless live editing.

Module Manager

Easily enable or disable individual Divi modules to enhance page speed and performance. Deactivate unnecessary modules to keep your site lean and efficient.

Expert Support

Our extraordinary support team is always ready to assist you. Ask your questions in the support forum or reach out directly through live chat or the contact form.

Divi Theme or Divi Builder is required for this plugin.

25+ FREE DIVI MODULES AND COUNTING

We’ve crafted over 25 of the most powerful widgets to enhance your Divi page-building experience and help you reach new heights in your design capabilities.

  1. Icon Box – Merge icons and text harmoniously with the Divi Icon Box, illustrating concepts or services in a visually appealing and informative manner.
  2. Contact Form 7 Styler – Seamlessly integrate the popular Contact Form 7 plugin with the Divi Contact Form 7 module, facilitating easy and efficient communication for users.
  3. Separator – Use the Separator module to add clear and customizable dividers between sections, enhancing your site’s structure and readability.
  4. Skill Bar – Showcase skills and competencies with the Skill Bar module, featuring animated bars that visually represent proficiency levels.
  5. Divi Logo Grid – Present a clean and organized collection of logos with the Logo Grid module, ideal for highlighting clients, partners, or sponsors professionally.
  6. Person – Use the Person module to showcase team members or individual profiles, complete with photos, biographies, and social media links.
  7. Testimonial – The Testimonial module lets you easily add testimonial blocks to your website. Use these sections to showcase client, customer, or user feedback, reviews, or quotes.
  8. Info Box – The Info Box module is perfect for highlighting important information with customizable boxes, combining text and icons for clear communication.
  9. Info Card – Similar to the Info Box, the Info Card module lets you present key details in an engaging card format, enhancing your content’s visual appeal.
  10. Dual Button – Enhance your call-to-action with the Dual Button module, offering two interactive buttons that guide users towards different actions.
  11. Before & After Slider – Enable users to compare two images with the Before & After Slider module effortlessly. Featuring an interactive slider, it’s perfect for highlighting transformations or contrasts.
  12. Image Carousel – Enhance your website’s design with the Image Carousel module. Select beautiful photos and customize slider options to create the perfect image carousel for your site.
  13. Logo Carousel – Elegantly showcase client or partner logos with the Divi Logo Carousel, displaying your affiliations and enhancing your credibility.
  14. Number – Use the Number module to highlight statistics or key figures, making important numbers stand out on your site.
  15. Video Modal – Embed videos with the Divi Video Modal, offering a sleek and responsive viewing experience that harmoniously integrates with your site’s aesthetic.
  16. Scroll Image – Integrate vertical or horizontal scrolling images with the Divi Image Scroll, adding depth and intrigue to your site while uniquely presenting your content.
  17. News Ticker – Keep your audience informed with the News Ticker module, displaying real-time updates or important announcements.
  18. Post List – Organize and display blog posts or articles in a list format, enhancing content navigation and accessibility.
  19. Review Box – Showcase customer feedback using the Divi Review Box, highlighting testimonials that build trust and credibility for your brand in a visually appealing manner.
  20. Flip Card – Show images and text cards that flip to reveal additional content on the other side when clicked.
  21. Animated Text – Capture attention with the Animated Text module, which allows you to create dynamic and engaging text animations.
  22. Business Hours – Display your business’s hours and opening times with the Opening Hours module.
  23. Gradient Heading – The Divi Gradient Heading adds a vibrant touch to your text, utilizing stunning gradient effects to draw attention and enhance visual appeal.
  24. Inline Notice – The Inline Notice module is a simple Divi module that helps you highlight important notes. Its ready-to-use box lets you quickly add text. You can customize the look with layouts, colors, and typography options.

More modules (50+) on Premium Version

  1. Image Zoom – Add interactive zoom effects to images, enhancing engagement on your website.
  2. Related Posts – Display related posts to keep visitors engaged with similar content.
  3. Masonry Gallery – Showcase images in a beautiful, organized masonry layout.
  4. Ajax Search – Enable fast, live search results to improve user experience.
  5. Post Carousel – Highlight posts in a dynamic carousel slider.
  6. Post Grid – Display posts in a versatile grid layout for easy navigation.
  7. Lottie Animation – Bring your website to life with interactive Lottie animations.
  8. WhatsApp Chat – Add a WhatsApp chat button to connect with visitors directly.
  9. Video Modal – Open videos in sleek, interactive modals for better presentation.
  10. Timeline – Visually represent events or steps in an organized timeline.
  11. Testimonials – Display customer testimonials to build trust and credibility.
  12. Telegram Chat – Allow visitors to connect through Telegram directly from your website.
  13. Team Module – Introduce your team members with beautifully designed profiles.
  14. Stats Grid – Display key statistics with visual flair to capture visitor interest.
  15. Star Rating – Let users rate products or services using star-based reviews.
  16. Social Share – Enable visitors to easily share your content across social media.
  17. Review Card – Showcase customer reviews in a visually appealing card layout.
  18. Restro Menu – Create a restaurant menu that is easy to navigate and visually appealing.
  19. Progress Bar – Show progress on projects, achievements, or skills with visual bars.
  20. Pricing Table – Present your pricing plans in a clear, easy-to-read table format.
  21. Logo List – Display logos to highlight clients, partners, or features.
  22. Logo Carousel – Showcase logos in a dynamic, rotating carousel.
  23. Instagram Chat – Connect visitors to your Instagram through an easy chat link.
  24. Inline SVG – Add scalable vector graphics to your site for high-quality visuals.
  25. Info Card – Present information attractively with interactive info cards.
  26. Image Scroll – Add a smooth scrolling effect to images to captivate users.
  27. Image Hotspots – Highlight key areas on an image with interactive hotspots.
  28. Icon List – Create lists with visually appealing icons for easy readability.
  29. Icon Box – Showcase features or services using icons in stylish boxes.
  30. Horizontal Timeline – Display events or milestones in a horizontal timeline format.
  31. Heading – Customize headings with unique styles to make your text stand out.
  32. Gravity Forms – Integrate and style Gravity Forms for seamless use on your site.
  33. Gradient Heading – Add gradient colors to headings for a striking visual effect.
  34. Fluent Forms – Integrate Fluent Forms for easy data collection.
  35. Flip Box – Add interactive flip boxes for an engaging way to display content.
  36. Divi Filterable Gallery – Showcase images in a gallery with filtering options.
  37. Divider – Separate content elegantly with customizable dividers.
  38. Countdown – Add countdown timers to create urgency for events or promotions.
  39. Content Toggle – Allow users to switch between different content with toggles.
  40. Contact Form 7 – Integrate and style Contact Form 7 for seamless form handling.
  41. Before & After Slider – Compare images with a slider that reveals before/after views.
  42. Checkmark List – Use checkmark icons to make lists visually clear and easy to understand.
  43. Carousel Module – Display content dynamically in a customizable carousel.
  44. Business Hours – Show your business hours in an attractive, clear format.
  45. Blurb Module – Present content with an icon, image, and text to make it visually appealing.
  46. Basic List – Create clean, simple lists to present information effectively.
  47. Inline Notice – Add inline notices to grab attention for important messages.
  48. Instagram Feed – Showcase your latest Instagram posts directly on your website.
  49. Image Slider – Slide images in a beautiful marquee slider.

sections.installation:
Note: This plugin works with Divi. Make sure you have Divi Theme installed.

Install the Torque Modules either via the WordPress plugin directory or by uploading the files to your server at wp-content/plugins.

For more information, please visit our Knowledge Base.
sections.faq:
Is Divi Torque free?

Yes! Divi Torque Lite’s features are and always will be free.

Can I use Divi Torque Lite without Divi Theme/Builder?

I’m afraid, you cannot use Divi Torque Lite without Divi Theme/Builder.

Will Divi Torque Lite break my site after an update?

No, It won’t break your site or any page where you used our plugin. We put our best effort to make you happy. But we always recommend keeping a backup of your site before updating our plugin. In case anything happens you can revert and contact our support team immediately.
